title: Nonnegative transfer-matrix defect-resolvent envelope for coupled orientation histories
question: Can the unchanged R-454 source-plus-defect envelope accept a coupled vector history when every source-owned transfer matrix is entrywise nonnegative and has one common induced infinity-norm bound?
decision_reason: This is an additive T-054 admission interface after R-454. It generalizes the unchanged scalar path-product argument to coupled orientation/observable vectors without inventing a source-owned Q3 history, repeating a finite mobility or geometry table, or altering T-059/T-061.
decision_scope: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional nonnegative transfer-matrix path-product and defect-resolvent envelope. The result is a reusable owner contract only; it introduces no actual Q3 history, common domain, finite-grid extrapolation, physical selection, continuum limit, or tier change.
method: Load the hash-pinned R-454/R-453/R-451/R-450 parent contracts and recompute the inherited source decay r=(23/26)^4 and parent-derived source constant without fitting.

Unroll the componentwise vector recurrence h_R<=K_R h_(R-1)+u_R+d_R and check every transfer matrix for entrywise nonnegativity and the declared common infinity-row-sum bound before applying path-product domination.
Expand each source and defect birth term in the exact matrix order K_R through K_(j+1), bound its norm by kappa_bar^(R-j), and specialize geometric source/defect norms to the two-kernel envelope.

Check unequal-base and resonant closed forms, strict versus unit/superunit thresholds, dimensions 1--3, seven nonnegative matrix patterns, and 65 exact radius rows without treating the fixture as an exhaustion grid.

Run exact-Fraction primary and non-importing independent lanes, reject hostile sign/order/bound/threshold/finite-to-infinite/method/promotion mutations, compile Lean R455, and integrate all lanes with the source-owner and promotion firewalls explicit.
finding: For h_0=0 with nonnegative vectors and entrywise nonnegative K_R whose maximum absolute row sum is at most one common kappa_bar, the exact product K_R...K_(j+1) is dominated in induced infinity norm by kappa_bar^(R-j). Hence ||h_R||_infinity<=A*S_R(kappa_bar,r)+D*S_R(kappa_bar,s), with the unequal-base quotient and the resonant R*x^(R-1) branch. The sufficient decay threshold is kappa_bar<1 and s<1. Primary passes 373915/373915, independent 250290/250290, hostile rejects 20/20, integrated passes and Lean R455 compiles. Source-owned transfer matrices, common bound, vector recurrence/residual, common domain and downstream physical/continuum gates remain missing.
boundary: R-455 proves an abstract finite-dimensional norm implication only: an entrywise nonnegative coupled recurrence with one common induced infinity-norm bound has the R-454 source-plus-defect envelope. It does not supply a Q3 transfer law, common bound, common domain, residual, exhaustion map or any physical or continuum identification.
evidence_level: T0 exact conditional nonnegative transfer-matrix defect-stable vector history-resolvent envelope
assumptions: R-454 is the unchanged scalar parent interface and R-451/R-450 supply its geometric source envelope.
The coupled history error, source vectors and defect vectors are nonnegative and measured in one common infinity norm or form domain.
Every step transfer matrix is entrywise nonnegative and has a maximum absolute row sum bounded by one common kappa_bar across the intended history and nested-shape family.
The source and defect vector norms obey ||u_R||_infinity<=A*r^(R-1) and ||d_R||_infinity<=D*s^(R-1), with common nonnegative A,D,r,s.
Matrix monotonicity, induced-norm submultiplicativity and finite-sum identities are applied before any infinite-limit interpretation.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK derivation of the coupled transfer matrices, the componentwise recurrence and a common bound kappa_bar<1.
A source-owned vector source/defect sequence and uniformity of its norm bounds in shape, volume, cutoff, beta, phase and history depth.
A common unbounded operator or form domain on which the vector components and transfer law are defined.
A production all-shape exhaustion map identifying the same coupled observable across shapes and orientations.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, common alpha, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.

stop_or_redesign: If any transfer entry is negative or any row sum exceeds the submitted common bound, reject that owner packet and retain only the abstract norm identity.
If kappa_bar>=1 or s>=1, retain the exact conditional diagnostic but do not claim vanishing.
If the bound depends on shape, volume, cutoff, beta or history depth, do not call the envelope uniform.
If the common norm or domain is absent, do not convert the vector estimate into an operator or form theorem.
If a proposed use changes the established method or owner order, return to the continuity gate before proceeding.
non_claims: No source-owned Q3LOCK transfer matrices, componentwise recurrence, common row-sum bound, vector residual or defect envelope are established.
No common unbounded domain, form closure, source/volume/cutoff/beta uniformity or production exhaustion map is established.
The matrix envelope is not an OS/KMS/GNS, common-alpha, physical-sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result.
The dimensions, patterns and radius rows are exact finite checks and are not an exhaustion surrogate.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order and promotion firewalls remain unchanged.
next_action: When a source-owned Q3 history supplies coupled transfer matrices, verify entrywise nonnegativity, one common kappa_bar<1, the vector source and residual bounds, and instantiate R-455 before feeding the resulting norm envelope through R-454/R-453/R-451. Until then, continue the unchanged T-054 owner-intake boundary and additive T-059/T-061 observation-source lock without another finite mobility or geometry table.
